content: {"episode_id":"ep-05164","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I request reconsideration of the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, which was denied because required prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents exertional dyspnea and palpitations in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal arrhythmias that may be contributing to these symptoms and to guide further management of the underlying coronary and valvular pathology."}
